_comment: This file lists the three models, and the revision and request settings of each open-weight model.
The revision is a commit of the model's Hugging Face repository.
The fields hf_repo, revision, model, port and dtype are five arguments of the vllm serve command in README.md.
For the reported labels, we served both open-weight models with vLLM 0.19.1, torch 2.10.0 and CUDA 12.8.
The scripts label.py and gate.py send a model's requests to the URL in the environment variable that base_url_env names.
If that variable is not set, they use the port below on 127.0.0.1.

claude_sonnet5.note: Sonnet ran through an agentic command-line harness, not through label.py.
